# Revzion

> Revzion is a software engineering company based in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, India. It designs and builds SaaS platforms, AI-powered systems and cross-platform mobile apps. Founded as Next Level Programmers in 2019; operating as Revzion since 2024. Founder & CEO: Arqam Ahmad Siddiqui.

Contact: connect@revzion.in · https://www.revzion.in/contact
Legal entity: REVZION GLOBAL TECHNOLOGIES LLP (India)
Clients: India, Saudi Arabia, United Kingdom (see case studies)

## Services

- [Services](https://www.revzion.in/services): SaaS platforms, AI & automation, mobile & cross-platform (React Native, Kotlin Multiplatform), cloud & DevOps, data & intelligence, custom enterprise software (ERP, CRM, HRMS)
- [Process](https://www.revzion.in/process): discovery, weekly sprints with demos, launch, operate
- [Project estimate](https://www.revzion.in/estimate): scope and cost range via Buildarc, Revzion's estimation platform

## Case studies

- [Evolwe Ring](https://www.revzion.in/portfolio/evolwe-ring): smart ring companion app and product site (React Native, BLE, on-device ML, Next.js)
- [Cognivia](https://www.revzion.in/portfolio/cognivia): AI-first LMS for coaching institutes, Revzion product
- [Scottish Home Bargains](https://www.revzion.in/portfolio/scottish-home-bargains): UK home goods e-commerce with BNPL checkout
- [Mazencito](https://www.revzion.in/portfolio/mazencito): bilingual restaurant website, Jeddah
- [Everyday Fitness](https://www.revzion.in/portfolio/everyday-fitness): fitness studio website, India
